title: August and the Letter
author: Jonah Underhill
blurb: Felix Sandoval, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
